summary.text: A caller submits a cityId to Dashboard.savePlace. The handler serializes the body and sends POST /places with a 10-second abort signal; the declared OpenAPI request is an object containing only cityId, with oslo, helsinki, and lisbon as allowed values. The saved Dashboard-to-Places mapping is agent-proposed, so runtime target binding is not established. Places returns 400 UNSUPPORTED_CITY when its city mapping fails; otherwise it awaits repository.Save and returns 200. Save inserts the place in a database transaction, inserts a place.requested version 1 outbox record only when the place insert returns a new id, and commits. A conflict skips the outbox insert but still commits. Dashboard forwards a parsed upstream status/body, while a fetch or JSON parse exception returns 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; the wrapper has no retry and that response does not say whether the Places transaction committed. The no-outbox path is tied to the place INSERT returning null on conflict; that can reflect an existing city or another request, so it is not a retry guarantee for the timed-out caller. The saved process links publisher and consumer views separately; an outbox row is not proof of Kafka publication or consumption.

source.text:
name: clew-weather-demo
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18.3
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: weather
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: weather
    volumes:
      - weather-data:/var/lib/postgresql
      - ./database/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, pg_isready -U weather]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
  kafka:
    image: apache/kafka:4.1.2
    environment:
      KAFKA_NODE_ID: 1
      KAFKA_PROCESS_ROLES: broker,controller
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES: CONTROLLER
      KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS: 1@kafka:9093
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_MIN_ISR: 1
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: 'true'
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, '/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 30
  kafka-init:
    image: apache/kafka:4.1.2
    entrypoint: ["/bin/bash", "-ec"]
    command:
      - |
        for topic in weather.place-requested weather.forecast-updated; do
          /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic "$$topic" --partitions 1 --replication-factor 1
          /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --topic "$$topic"
        done
    depends_on:
      kafka: {condition: service_healthy}
  places:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/places/Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: Host=postgres;Database=places;Username=weather;Password=weather
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka:9092
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8081:8080']
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      kafka-init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
  forecasts:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/forecasts/Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/forecasts
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka:9092
      FORECAST_MODE: ${FORECAST_MODE:-fixture}
      MET_USER_AGENT: ${MET_USER_AGENT:-}
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8082:8080']
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      kafka-init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
  dashboard:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/dashboard/Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://weather:weather@postgres:5432/dashboard
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka:9092
      PLACES_URL: http://places:8080
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8080:8080']
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      kafka-init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
volumes:
  weather-data:

source.text:
name: clew-weather-demo
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18.3
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: weather
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: weather
    volumes:
      - weather-data:/var/lib/postgresql
      - ./database/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, pg_isready -U weather]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
  kafka:
    image: apache/kafka:4.1.2
    environment:
      KAFKA_NODE_ID: 1
      KAFKA_PROCESS_ROLES: broker,controller
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES: CONTROLLER
      KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS: 1@kafka:9093
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_MIN_ISR: 1
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: 'true'
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, '/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 30
  kafka-init:
    image: apache/kafka:4.1.2
    entrypoint: ["/bin/bash", "-ec"]
    command:
      - |
        for topic in weather.place-requested weather.forecast-updated; do
          /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic "$$topic" --partitions 1 --replication-factor 1
          /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --topic "$$topic"
        done
    depends_on:
      kafka: {condition: service_healthy}
  places:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/places/Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: Host=postgres;Database=places;Username=weather;Password=weather
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka:9092
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8081:8080']
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      kafka-init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
  forecasts:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/forecasts/Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/forecasts
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka:9092
      FORECAST_MODE: ${FORECAST_MODE:-fixture}
      MET_USER_AGENT: ${MET_USER_AGENT:-}
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8082:8080']
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      kafka-init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
  dashboard:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/dashboard/Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://weather:weather@postgres:5432/dashboard
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka:9092
      PLACES_URL: http://places:8080
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8080:8080']
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      kafka-init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
volumes:
  weather-data:

fragment.text: A caller submits a cityId to Dashboard.savePlace. The handler serializes the body and sends POST /places with a 10-second abort signal; the declared OpenAPI request is an object containing only cityId, with oslo, helsinki, and lisbon as allowed values. The saved Dashboard-to-Places mapping is agent-proposed, so runtime target binding is not established. Places returns 400 UNSUPPORTED_CITY when its city mapping fails; otherwise it awaits repository.Save and returns 200. Save inserts the place in a database transaction, inserts a place.requested version 1 outbox record only when the place insert returns a new id, and commits. A conflict skips the outbox insert but still commits. Dashboard forwards a parsed upstream status/body, while a fetch or JSON parse exception returns 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; the wrapper has no retry and that response does not say whether the Places transaction committed. The no-outbox path is tied to the place INSERT returning null on conflict; that can reflect an existing city or another request, so it is not a retry guarantee for the timed-out caller. The saved process links publisher and consumer views separately; an outbox row is not proof of Kafka publication or consumption.
